toolParams.sql:
SELECT
  toDate(ffilldate) AS fill_date,
  SUM(famt) AS payment_amount,
  COUNT(DISTINCT fid) AS payment_count
FROM yunnan0508.paybook_full_high
WHERE toDate(ffilldate) >= toDate('2024-01-01')
  AND toDate(ffilldate) <  toDate('2024-07-01')
GROUP BY fill_date
ORDER BY fill_date
WITH FILL
  FROM toDate('2024-01-01')
  TO    toDate('2024-06-30')
  STEP  toIntervalDay(1)
